prometheus_stopped.body:
# HELP atlas_up 1 while the game runs and answers
# TYPE atlas_up gauge
atlas_up 0
# HELP atlas_supervisor_uptime_seconds Seconds since atlas-server started
# TYPE atlas_supervisor_uptime_seconds gauge
atlas_supervisor_uptime_seconds <dynamic>
# HELP atlas_crashes Game crashes since atlas-server started
# TYPE atlas_crashes gauge
atlas_crashes 2
# HELP atlas_tps Ticks per second over the last 5 seconds
# TYPE atlas_tps gauge
atlas_tps 19.9
# HELP atlas_tps_target The tick rate the game aims for (/tick rate)
# TYPE atlas_tps_target gauge
atlas_tps_target 20
# HELP atlas_mspt Milliseconds per tick: the average and the percentiles /tick query reports
# TYPE atlas_mspt gauge
atlas_mspt{stat="average"} 8.25
atlas_mspt{stat="p50"} 7
atlas_mspt{stat="p95"} 12.5
atlas_mspt{stat="p99"} 18
# HELP atlas_players_online Players online
# TYPE atlas_players_online gauge
atlas_players_online 2
# HELP atlas_players_max max-players
# TYPE atlas_players_max gauge
atlas_players_max 20
# HELP atlas_chunks_loaded Chunks loaded
# TYPE atlas_chunks_loaded gauge
atlas_chunks_loaded 321
# HELP atlas_memory_rss_bytes The game process's resident memory
# TYPE atlas_memory_rss_bytes gauge
atlas_memory_rss_bytes 536870912
# HELP atlas_cpu_percent The game process's CPU use (100 = one core)
# TYPE atlas_cpu_percent gauge
atlas_cpu_percent 12.5
